_comment: CarbonShift solver battery test configuration (Rust nshift binary only).
_phases_comment: Each phase is independently toggled by leaving its content list(s) empty: DP runs only if batch_sizes is non-empty; online runs only if online_strategies is non-empty; offline runs only if additional_strategies is non-empty. See tests/battery/multiple_runs.py for phase-aware parameter grids that avoid redundantly re-running phases a given knob doesn't affect.
_trim_future_assignments_comment: Optional. When true, requests are still generated only in each scenario's total_slots, but the planning horizon and carbon forecast extend by ERROR_WINDOW_FUTURE slots. Assignments and request-level metrics beyond the configured total_slots are trimmed; reqs_in counts scenario inputs and reqs_out counts retained assignments.
_input_pattern_comment: Simulation-only request pattern: sinusoidal follows the daylight load wave; flat keeps a nearly constant rate with seeded 5%-of-rate slot-count jitter and the same rounded horizon total. Sinusoidal scenarios may also set carbon_request_alignment (in-phase, phase-opposition, phase-shifted), carbon_phase_shift_fraction (0.0-0.5), and request_pattern_start (low/high). Both retain random sub-slot arrival times. This does not configure client emulation.
_online_batch_sizes_comment: Batch sizes swept ONLY by online_strategies, independent of the DP phase's batch_sizes above. Omit to fall back to batch_sizes. ant_colony, bandit, hazard, and singleton_best use this sweep.
_flavours_comment: Optional flavour override shared by the baseline and every enabled phase/scenario. Edit this list to use any subset (for example, keep only Accurate), or set flavours to null to use nshift's built-in defaults.
_runtime_knobs_comment: Runtime knobs below mirror the Rust solver configuration; omit them to use the documented defaults.
_aco_search_comment: nshift simulation ACO defaults. Each batch automatically scales down ants and iterations, preserving their ratio, if their product exceeds future-window slots * flavours * batch size. The live service does not use this cap.
